entities.name: Rhuk
entities.description: A goblin armorer and rebel on New Phyrexia who perfected hexgold forging and armed the Mirran resistance.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane where Rhuk is a rebel.

entities.name: Hexgold
entities.description: A phyresis-preventing material forged by Rhuk.

relations.note: He created many of the best weapons the resistance wielded.
relations.quote: created many of the best weapons that the Mirran resistance ever wielded
